items.quote: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: Cloths of service and holy garments were made from blue, purple, and scarlet materials for the holy place and for Aaron, following divine command.
items.object: cloths of service; holy garments for Aaron
